description: One tessellation pattern drawn at three places by one lit primitive of three solids, plus a transparent double-sided material and a lines primitive. Triangle t (0 <= t < patternTriangles) of a copy with offset (ox, oy, oz) has the corners (ox + t, oy, oz), (ox + t + 0.5, oy + 1, oz), (ox + t + 1, oy, oz) and the indices (3t, 3t + 1, 3t + 2) counted from the first vertex of its copy; every vertex of a copy has the normal of that copy. The lines draw the first triangle of every copy as the segments (3t, 3t + 1) and (3t + 1, 3t + 2).
